release.name: Separate authorized manual Round 1 scheduling; automatic Outlook path remains blocked

changeDecision.reason: A distinct RecordManualRound1Schedule ActionType and additive manualSchedulingOperational capability reuse existing typed inputs and ScopedData. No provider flags, extra step, handler or execute-privilege change.

manualScheduling.label: Manual Scheduling — availability not checked
manualScheduling.authority: Owner-requested fallback and MASTER_PRODUCTION_RULES Phase 5A manual decision scope.
manualScheduling.authorization: Authenticated initiating actor, enabled exact-organization policy, effective Read and Write on the exact Candidate, Active caller-visible TA/Location; no nonempty SyntheticScopeId.
manualScheduling.inputs: Explicit Room, TA, date and future start/end on the same SE Asia local date; optional exact Notes. No availability assertion or client provider evidence.
manualScheduling.persistence: Canonical transactional new Active schedule or Proposed-to-Active promotion, optimistic concurrency, Candidate Waiting-to-Scheduled, one History and action-fingerprinted Receipt. New schedule caller ownership; promotion ownership unchanged. Replay does not duplicate.
manualScheduling.notes: Nonblank text preserved exactly; explicitly blank clears, omitted Notes preserve existing Proposed-row Notes.
manualScheduling.audit: History and Receipt persist the separate action; History states availability not checked and no Outlook meeting/invitation created.
manualScheduling.console: Explicit manual method, UTC+07:00 input labels, required references/date/times, capability gating, duplicate/ambiguous-outcome blocking and exact persisted readback before one success dialog.

normalScheduling.automaticSaveBoundary: Unchanged MarkRound1Scheduled requires fresh server-fetched evidence before both creation and promotion. No manual flag or client Free/Busy input can bypass it. SingleUserDev retains the existing scoped operation.
normalScheduling.technicalDependency: No supported authenticated runtime delegation/invocation adapter from the current WebResource/Dataverse server to the existing Outlook connection is established. The webhook Flow returns meeting suggestions through the elevated result writer, not complete server-trusted Room/TA coverage. Implement and verify that adapter and complete correlated coverage without SAS/Anyone, new identities or elevated result-writer attestation.
